Level-12 of Pay Matrix (₹78,800–2,09,200), 7th Pay Commission
Initial posting at ICMR-NIRBI, Kolkata; all India transfer liability

content_sections.heading: About ICMR
content_sections.text: The Indian Council of Medical Research is an autonomous organisation under the Department of Health Research, Ministry of Health and Family Welfare, Government of India. According to the notice, ICMR works on biomedical and health research through its headquarters in New Delhi, its 29 institutes/centres across the country and a large number of field stations, in collaboration with national and international agencies. This Scientist-D post will initially be posted at ICMR-NIRBI, Kolkata.

content_sections.heading: Who Can Apply
content_sections.text: Only Indian citizens can apply. The essential and desirable requirements printed for the post are: Desirable experience: research and development experience related to Biomedical Sciences in a Government/Public Sector/Private institution, matching the needs of the post, that is, research on structural biology using cryo-electron microscope (Cryo-EM) for biological samples, especially macromolecular complexes, with the use of Cryo-EM reconstruction algorithms and computational skills. A PhD will be considered as equal to 4 years of experience, irrespective of the time taken to complete the degree. MD/MS or equivalent will be counted as 3 years of experience. MVSc will be counted as 2 years of experience. MPH/MTech/ME will not be counted as experience of any kind. R&D experience in biomedical sciences in Government/Public Sector/Private institutions is accepted only when it matches the work expected from the post. The period spent in obtaining the minimum essential educational qualification will not be counted as experience (applies to the PhD, MD/MS and MVSc rules above). Qualification and experience may be relaxed for a candidate with a higher category of qualification, with the approval of the Director General, ICMR, for reasons recorded in writing. Candidates must meet all eligibility conditions by the last date of application; the online system will not accept an application from a candidate who does not. The maximum age limit is 45 years, with relaxation as per Government of India instructions. The notice does not print a separate cut-off date for age.

rows.details: Postgraduate degree in a subject related to Biomedical Sciences from a recognised university, OR Pharm-D degree recognised by UGC/PCI
Ph.D. in Biophysics/Molecular Biology/Biochemistry from a recognised university

content_sections.heading: Pay and Tenure
content_sections.text: The Scientist-D (Non-Medical) post is filled by direct recruitment in Level-12 of the Pay Matrix (₹78,800–2,09,200) under the 7th Pay Commission. The pay comes with the usual allowances admissible, as per rules, to employees of the Council appointed on a regular basis. The post carries all India transfer liability, although the initial posting is at ICMR-NIRBI, Kolkata.

content_sections.heading: Application Fee
content_sections.text: The fee is paid through the online link given in the application form, only by Net Banking, Credit Card or Debit Card. An application without the full fee paid in the prescribed manner may be rejected.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for ICMR Scientist-D (Non-Medical)
content_sections.text: Register on https://recruitment.icmr.org.in and fill in the mandatory registration details carefully; registration details cannot be changed after registration. An acknowledgement is sent to the registered email ID/mobile number. Click 'Applicant Login' and sign in with the user ID and password received on your email and mobile number. Click 'Go to Application Form' and fill the form section by section, using 'Save and Next'; you cannot move ahead until mandatory details are filled and required documents are uploaded. Upload the photograph, signature and documents as per the instructions. After the last section, click 'Submit'; you will be redirected to pay the fee. The application is complete once payment is made. Take the final print of the application if needed. Submit a hard copy (final printout) with all uploaded documents only when the Council asks for it. Offline or downloaded application forms will not be accepted, and no request to change any detail will be considered after submission. Self-attested/certified scanned copies of educational qualifications from Matriculation onwards Detailed marks sheets of all courses Proof of date of birth Caste certificate (SC/ST/OBC/PwD), where applicable Experience certificates Unattested photograph (no cap or coloured glasses; spectacles allowed) and signature The list of rejection reasons also names the MCI registration certificate and an EWS certificate among documents that must be uploaded where applicable. A candidate who fails to upload the self-attested documents will have the candidature cancelled and will not be allowed in later stages of selection.

content_sections.heading: Selection and Interview
content_sections.text: Selection will be made on the basis of a Computer Based Test (multiple choice questions), or an interview, or both. If a Computer Based Test is held, it will test understanding of research methods and will be aptitude based. First, all candidates meeting the minimum eligibility of age, essential qualification and essential experience will be shortlisted. If too many candidates are shortlisted to call all for interview, ICMR will shortlist further on suitable criteria decided by its competent authority. ICMR generally prefers to call candidates with higher experience in the relevant field or higher educational qualification, as decided by the appointing authority. Documents are not checked at the time of online submission; they are verified at shortlisting.

content_sections.heading: Important Instructions
content_sections.text: Applicants working in Central/State Government departments, Public Sector Undertakings or government-funded research agencies must produce, at the personal discussion, a No Objection Certificate from the employer undertaking that they will be relieved within one month of receiving the appointment order. Applications received after the last date will be rejected, whatever the reason; incomplete applications or those without supporting documents will also be rejected. Duplicate applications from one applicant will all be rejected without intimation. If any information is found false or any eligibility condition unmet at any stage, even after appointment, the candidature will be cancelled and criminal proceedings may follow. Any outside influence, political or otherwise, will disqualify the candidate. Keep identical photographs for the test or document verification; a mismatch between the photo and the candidate may lead to rejection. The number of vacancies is tentative and may change; ICMR may amend, cancel or re-issue the notice. Updates will appear only on www.icmr.gov.in . Any dispute is subject to the jurisdiction of courts in New Delhi. For technical or payment queries, call 011-26589167 (9:30 AM to 5:30 PM IST, working days) or email [email protected] .
